subject: Renewal engagement brief & QBR slot request
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@brightpath.ai>; procurement@brightpath.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal engagement brief & QBR slot request

Hi Elena / BrightPath team,

Congrats on another year — and thanks for the continued partnership. With your renewal coming up in early Dec, I wanted to share a short engagement brief so we can align on term options, capacity uplift, and an initial QBR window. High level: 

- Renewal window: contract expires 2026-12-15; target execution by 2026-11-30 to allow procurement lead time.
- Capacity: current commit is 120M tokens/month; BrightPath is forecasting +40–60% peak growth on inference in Jan/Feb. We should discuss burst add-on vs stepped commit.
- Term options: 12 vs 24 month pricing matrix; 24-month provides ~12% unit discount and predictable capacity reservations.
- Key stakeholders: Elena (Finance/Exec), Procurement inbox, Redwood CS (Marissa), Solutions (Ben), Technical AM (Soojin).

Next steps I propose:
1) Quick QBR to review usage trends and capacity forecast (30–45m) — please propose 2 available slots in the next 10 business days.
2) I’ll attach a draft SOW and a straw pricing/commit matrix for discussion.
3) If procurement prefers, we can route commercial paperwork through your procurement email and include redline deadlines.

I've attached a draft SOW and a tentative calendar invite (QBR-availability.ics). If you want a deeper technical readout, Soojin can run a 15m pre-read.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: BrightPath_SOW_Draft.pdf (pdf)]
From: Elena Morales <elena@brightpath.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightpath.ai; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal engagement brief & QBR slot request

Thanks Rafael — this looks good. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Procurement prefers to complete contractor paperwork by 11/24 to close before the holidays. 11/30 is tight for legal.
- Finance (me) wants to review the stepped commit vs burst model; can you include an example of unit economics for the two options?
- We definitely need the QBR week of 11/9 — I can do 11/10 AM or 11/12 PM.

I’m looping procurement so they see timelines. Attaching our procurement checklist for reference.

—Elena
Elena Morales
VP Finance, BrightPath AI
[Attachment: BrightPath_Procurement_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)]

Adding a quick ops note:

- Marissa: I’ll bring token-level cost/latency dashboards and a 15m usage segmentation so Finance can see peak hour behavior.
- Ben: can you prepare two scenario slides (stepped commit and burst overlay with estimated monthly unit costs)? Aim for simple charts — Elena needs unit economics.
- Soojin: please confirm whether the 40–60% forecast needs GPU sizing changes (I can set a short pre-read).

I’m available 11/10 AM and will take the 11/12 PM slot if the team needs it instead. Rafael — happy for you to lock whichever Elena confirms.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

- Elena confirmed 11/10 AM PT for the QBR — I’ve shared a calendar hold (please accept).
- Ben will deliver the pricing scenarios by 11/03 EOD.
